svg.title: The Mill: Cast bronze with patina
svg.desc: The Mill (1D): a nine men's morris board cast as a bronze plaque, three nested squares joined at their midpoints, every point a raised boss. The keeper's pieces are polished bronze; the Ghost's are the same casting gone dark with matte verdigris patina. Across the board a mill of his, three in a row, is lit by a raised bar, and one of her pieces has been lifted off the board. At the plaque's edge two bronze hands, nothing more of him, make a sign; her side of the border is cast with a line of verse, his with the shape of a desk and a chair.
svg.text: AND THE CAGED WENT UP THE MOUNTAIN ON THE BREATH
